en: Ugh... What do I do from here?
Exal!!
Whoa-whoa-whoa!!

jp: 壁なんかに張り付いて？
en: What's wrong? Why are you flattened against the wall?
C-Cain!?
...Hang on.
What are you guys doing here!?

jp: 帰ってくるのが遅いから
en: You were taking so long to come back, we came looking for you.

jp: よく無事でここまでこれたよな
en: ...Amazing you two made it this far in one piece.
Did something happen?

jp: 奥の方をのぞいてみな
en: ...Yeah, sort of. Take a peek further in.
...Quietly, now.
Further in?
Demons!?

jp: 気付かれたらどうするんだよ！！
en: Shhhh!! Keep your voice down!! What if they notice us!?
...Sorry.

jp: 奴らが街を襲っていた
渇きに狂った悪魔だとすると、
en: If those are the Thirst-mad demons that hit the town, is everyone in there dead?
Probably.

jp: やつら様子がおかしい
普通の渇きに狂った悪魔じゃない
en: But... something's off about them. They're not normal Thirst-crazed demons.
What do you mean?

jp: 誰かの命令なんて聞かないだろ？
en: Demons gone mad with the Thirst don't take orders from anyone, right?

jp: 顔は見えなかったけれど
奴らに指示を与えている悪魔が
en: I couldn't see its face, but there was a demon in there giving them orders.

jp: 統率する悪魔か・・・
en: A demon commanding those misshapen things...

jp: そんなことを言っていた
en: It was saying something like "find the Incest."
Incest?

jp: はっきり聞いたわけじゃない
でも、そんな事を言っていた
en: I didn't hear it clearly. But that's what it sounded like.

jp: リーダーらしき悪魔がいなく
なったとたん、あいつら・・・
en: And then, the moment the leader-looking demon left, those things...

jp: 食事を始めたんだ・・・
en: They started eating...

jp: 死体を食い始めやがった！！
en: They... they started eating the corpses!!

jp: 冗談じゃないぜ・・・
en: You've got to be kidding me...

jp: 鼻を突く血の臭い・・・
en: The raw color of the flesh, the crunch of bones, the stink of blood in my nose...

jp: 俺、頭がおかしくなるかと思った
en: I thought I was gonna lose my mind.
Exal...
...I'm okay.

jp: 震えが止まらないけどな
en: Still can't quite stop shaking, though.
Exal, let's get out of here, quick!

jp: せめて奴らの正体を確認して
en: No, not yet. I at least want to find out what those things really are.

jp: あれが、渇きに狂った悪魔
en: What they are...? They're demons driven mad by the Thirst, aren't they!?

jp: エクサルの話が本当なら
奴らは渇きに狂った悪魔ではない
en: No, Cain. If what Exal says is true, those are not demons maddened by the Thirst.

jp: 渇きに狂った悪魔でさえ
死肉をむさぼることはない
en: Even a demon mad with the Thirst does not devour dead flesh.
That is something far more abominable.

jp: 動き始めたようだぜ・・・
en: Looks like they've started moving...
You're going, Exal?

jp: やつらのねぐらを確認したら
俺もすぐに引き返すよ
en: It's fine, I tell you. Once I've found their nest, I'll come straight back.
I'm coming with you.

jp: 後で後悔しても知らないからな
en: ...Suit yourself. Don't blame me if you regret it later.
Yeah.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
